Name: Dodai the Ahohite
Summary: Captain over the course of the second month, of whom Mikloth was also ruler.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:4: Captain over the course of the second month, of whom Mikloth was also ruler.
LifeLesson: The mention of Dodai in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
